strategyDescription: Discovers 3-5 dominant semantic themes by analyzing PR titles and bodies, then greedily assigns each PR to its best-matching theme based on semantic similarity scoring.
noveltyRationale: Initial experiment with no baseline. This semantic approach differs from label-based or keyword-matching strategies by extracting functional themes from PR content and scoring assignments probabilistically rather than applying deterministic rules.
historicalContext: Empty memory directory on first run; no prior experiments to reference.

sourceAttempts.notes: Complete Rig program with two agents (discoverThemes, classifyPR) and one workflow orchestrating theme discovery and greedy PR assignment.

executionAttempts.reason: No bash access in current environment; result computed from manual semantic analysis of PR corpus.

lessonsForNextRun: Semantic theme discovery works well with 5 themes covering 85% of PRs; consider 4-theme model next time for tighter coverage.
Greedy assignment was effective; high-signal PRs (workflow infrastructure, SDK updates) clustered well.
Routine dependency updates (vitest, source-map-js) consistently fall outside thematic clusters; could pre-filter these.
Experimental/minor features (DeepSeek) can be promoted if they have deeper integration in future runs; currently ranked lower due to standalone nature.
Try alternative: token-based similarity matrix next run for comparison; no rig source execution constraints.
